questions.q: What is the most reliable first step when encountering an unfamiliar key word in a senior secondary Hindi prose text?
questions.a: The most reliable first step is to locate all occurrences of the word in the chapter and examine the immediate syntactic environment (subject, verb, modifiers) of each occurrence. A wrong answer like "look up the dictionary meaning first" reveals the student treats vocabulary as static rather than context-dependent, missing how authors redefine terms for argumentative purposes.
